caption: The drawing shows a wooden secretary desk with a closed base and an open upper section. The main body is rectangular with four wide drawers stacked vertically, each fitted with ornate brass handles. The upper portion of the desk features a hinged flap that is opened and supported horizontally, serving as a writing surface. Above the writing surface, the interior is visible, displaying several small drawers—four in total—arranged in a single row at the top, each with a small round knob. Below these, there are six small arched cubbyholes or compartments. The desk appears to be constructed of a medium-brown wood, with variations in the wood grain visible throughout the drawing. The bottom of the desk has short, bracket-style feet. The composition places the desk on a plain light background, with no other objects or decorations present.
title: Desk
